methodology.construction: A capitalisation-weighted index moves when market caps move. Each scored stock's point contribution = shares x (close - previous close) / divisor, with the OFFICIAL divisor — the official total market capitalisation divided by the index level, a near-constant Rs ~1.72 billion per point that the archived EOD snapshots pin down session by session. Sector contributions are the sum of their stocks' points; sector contributions plus the printed residual sum exactly to the official move.
methodology.shares: Share counts, in priority order: paid-up capital from the latest published quarterly filings compilation / Rs 100 par; the ownership archive's identity paid-up (same compilation family, carried per stock in the verdicts data); and, for the few ordinary shares both miss (NRIC and BBC among them), the total implied by that archive's measured float — float shares / (1 - promoter %), ownership as of 2024-07-19. Counts refresh at quarterly compilations, so a bonus or right issue allotted mid-quarter enters this board's weights at the next compilation.
methodology.prices: Final revised closes: the adjusted OHLC archive where it covers a symbol (it also neutralises the mechanical ex-date price drop the way the official divisor does), else the raw OHLC archive. The raw archive's 2026-10-14 bars are a preliminary vintage — over half differ from the final closes — which is what pricing this board off raw closes alone got wrong in v1. Volume and turnover are the session's, from the same bar that priced the row.
methodology.residual: The residual is the net move of everything the official index counts that this board cannot score — ordinary shares with no share count in either source, newly listed names not yet in any compilation (BENH, listed 2026-10-15, is the current example) — plus any official divisor adjustment for listings and corporate actions. Debentures and mutual funds are not constituents of the NEPSE equity index and are excluded from this board entirely. The residual is printed in the sector table so the table sums to the official move; it is measured, never plugged.
methodology.tolerance: If the residual ever exceeds +/-2.5 points, or scored cap coverage of the official total market capitalisation falls under 85.0%, the daily build fails instead of publishing. The residual tolerance is set from the v2 model's five-session validation (worst observed |residual| 0.72 pts, Oct 2026).
methodology.live: Between 11:00 and 15:00 on trading days this board is rebuilt every five minutes from the live quote feed: last-traded prices stand in for closes, the divisor and the weights are carried from the previous session's official EOD state (the divisor is a within-day constant), and volume and turnover are cumulative for the session so far. It is marked LIVE and provisional; after the close the final board — priced on final revised closes — replaces it on this same page and is the board that enters the ledger.
